evidence_summary.operator_summary:
Simulation completed, and the proposed strategy mostly behaved as expected. Deployment is possible, but it requires operator acknowledgement because there are non-blocking risks.

The main issue is not that the robots failed to sort the tools shown in the simulation. The simulation was limited to 3 tools per line, but the KPI checker still expected the full 27-tool environment to be completed.

line_1 sorted all 3 tools shown in the simulation. The completed set contained 3 required ENT tools and 0 unwanted tools. The table batch completed without a real next-batch gating violation. No misplaced tools or entanglements were recorded. The KPI failure appears to come from the checker expecting the full 27-tool environment instead of the 3 tools shown in this run.

line_2 sorted all 3 tools shown in the simulation. The completed set contained 2 required ENT tools and 1 unwanted tool. The table batch completed without a real next-batch gating violation. No misplaced tools or entanglements were recorded. The KPI failure appears to come from the checker expecting the full 27-tool environment instead of the 3 tools shown in this run.

line_3 sorted all 3 tools shown in the simulation. The completed set contained 3 required ENT tools and 0 unwanted tools. The table batch completed without a real next-batch gating violation. No misplaced tools or entanglements were recorded. The KPI failure appears to come from the checker expecting the full 27-tool environment instead of the 3 tools shown in this run.

line_4 sorted all 3 tools shown in the simulation. The completed set contained 1 required ENT tool and 2 unwanted tools. The table batch completed without a real next-batch gating violation. line_4 warning: tool_03 was sent to UNWANTED_BOX, but the result database marked it as not correctly placed. The KPI failure appears to come from the checker expecting the full 27-tool environment instead of the 3 tools shown in this run.

Deployment is allowed with acknowledgement, but not automatically recommended. Recommended next step: update the KPI checker so a limited-tool simulation is evaluated against the tools actually shown, or clearly mark it as a partial-table run, then rerun the simulation.
